scope.description: Package epaxos records written by recordInstanceMetadata while Durable is true, for instances whose bal and vbal differ; the record layout is the 9+r.N*4 byte form the function builds.
assumptions: The second PutUint32 in recordInstanceMetadata is not intended to overwrite the first, i.e. the function intends to persist both bal and vbal.
StableStore accepts the write as given; the obligation is about the bytes produced, not about fsync ordering.
excluded: Non-durable runs, where recordInstanceMetadata returns immediately.
Any restart/replay semantics, which no captured file implements.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Test-only harness file added under epaxos/assurance_generated_test.go; no target source or protocol logic is modified.
StableStore is provided as an os.Pipe so the record bytes can be read without touching the filesystem.
The harness calls recordInstanceMetadata directly rather than driving a full replica, because the obligation constrains the bytes this function writes.

plan_uncertainties: The check observes only the bytes the function writes; it does not observe any restart that would consume the record, because no such reader exists in the captured files.
grounding_unresolved: No normative source outside the implementation was found for the record layout.
No reader of the record was found, so the consequence for recovery is inferred rather than demonstrated.
No in-repository reader of the record was found, so the consequence of the lost bal for recovery is not part of this observation.
